Mit rund 10.000 Mitarbeitern und derzeit 12 beruflichen Ausbildungsströmen bietet die Universität ein inspirierendes Arbeitsumfeld für Spitzenforschung und erstklassige Bildung. Setzen Sie Ihr Talent und Ihre Fähigkeiten ein, um mit uns zu arbeiten. Erfahren Sie mehr über die UZH als Arbeitgeber! Aufgaben: Im Rahmen des SNF-Projekts wird sich das EcoVision Lab darauf konzentrieren, die Waldparameterschätzung, insbesondere die Baumkronenhöhe, auf der detailliertesten Ebene voranzutreiben. Als Doktorand werden Sie neuartige Deep Learning- und Computer Vision-Methoden entwickeln, um groß angelegte Fernerkundungsbilder verschiedener Satellitenmissionen in Karten der Baumkronenhöhe und weitere Waldparameter und deren Veränderung im Laufe der Zeit zu transformieren. Ihre Forschung umfasst:
• Entwicklung von Deep-Learning-Modellen für Satellitenbild-Zeitreihenanalyse und Domänenadaption
• Entwicklung von Deep-Learning-Modellen für (geführte) Superauflösung historischer Satellitenbilder
• Erstellung kalibrierter Unsicherheitsschätzungen für alle Modellergebnisse
• Trainingsmodelle zu heterogenen Datenquellen (z. B. Landsat, Sentinel-2, SPOT, Corona) und die Erforschung multimodaler Kombinationen verschiedener Datenquellen. Forschungsfreiheit und methodische Innovation Das Projekt bietet erhebliche Freiheiten, um wirkungsvolle methodische Richtungen in der modernen KI zu erforschen, darunter: selbstüberwachtes Lernen, multimodales Lernen, (geführte) Superauflösung, Unsicherheitsschätzung, Zeitreihenregression. Unser Ziel sind wirkungsvolle Veröffentlichungen sowohl in Orten des maschinellen Lernens (z. B. CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, ICLR, NeurIPS) als auch in führenden interdisziplinären Zeitschriften wie Remote Sensing of Environment, ISPRS Journal und Nature Sustainability. Warum beitreten? Diese 2x PhD Positionen bieten:
• Werden Sie Teil des EcoVision Lab, einem lebendigen, aufregenden und unterhaltsamen Ort, um Deep Learning für Anwendungen in der Ökologie zu erforschen
• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit führenden Forschungsgruppen in den Bereichen maschinelles Lernen, Computer Vision, Data Science, Fernerkundung und historische Fernerkundungsbildinterpretation.
• Eine einzigartige Gelegenheit, innovative KI-Forschung mit realen Umweltauswirkungen für ein noch völlig unerforschtes Forschungsthema zu kombinieren
• Zugang zu diversen, groß angelegten historischen Satellitenbildarchiven Anforderungen: Wir suchen hochmotivierte Kandidaten, die sich dafür begeistern, die Grenzen des maschinellen Lernens zu erweitern und gleichzeitig zu sinnvollen Umweltauswirkungen beizutragen. Sie sind neugierig, streng und entwickeln gerne neue Ideen und hochwertige Forschungssoftware. Sie beschäftigen sich gerne mit herausfordernden Problemen und arbeiten disziplinübergreifend zusammen. Ein idealer Kandidat hat:
• Ein exzellenter Master-Abschluss (M.Sc. oder gleichwertig) in Informatik, Machine Learning, Data Science oder einem eng verwandten Bereich (z. B. Elektrotechnik, Angewandte Mathematik)
• Eine starke Grundlage in Mathematik und maschinellem Lernen
• Viel Programmiererfahrung, vorzugsweise in Python
• Starke Vorkenntnisse in Deep Learning und Computer Vision
• Interesse an der Anwendung fortschrittlicher ML-Methoden auf ökologische und geospatiale Daten
• Fließend in Englisch (geschrieben und gesprochen) ist erforderlich Erfahrung mit Themen wie selbstüberwachtem Lernen, Domänenadaption, Transferlernen, multimodalem Lernen, Unsicherheitsschätzung ist ein Plus - aber nicht unbedingt erforderlich. Wir engagieren uns für den Aufbau eines vielfältigen und integrativen Forschungsumfelds. Wir empfehlen Bewerbungen von Kandidaten aller Herkunft und begrüßen insbesondere diejenigen, die möglicherweise nicht alle aufgeführten Kriterien erfüllen, aber eine starke Motivation und Potenzial mitbringen. Wir bieten: Unsere Mitarbeiter profitieren von einer breiten Palette attraktiver Angebote. Weitere Informationen finden Sie unter https://www.uzh.ch/de/explore/work.html.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
L'Université de Zurich, la plus grande université de Suisse, offre une gamme de postes attrayants dans différents domaines et domaines professionnels. Avec environ 10 000 employés et actuellement 12 filières d'apprentissage professionnel, l'Université offre un environnement de travail inspirant sur la recherche de pointe et l'éducation de haut niveau. Mettez votre talent et vos compétences au travail avec nous. En savoir plus sur UZH en tant qu'employeur! Aufgaben: Dans le cadre du projet SNSF, EcoVision Lab s'attachera à faire progresser l'estimation des paramètres forestiers, en particulier la hauteur du couvert, au niveau le plus détaillé. En tant que candidat au doctorat, vous développerez de nouvelles méthodes d'apprentissage profond et de vision informatique pour transformer l'imagerie de télédétection à grande échelle de différentes missions satellitaires en cartes de hauteur du couvert, ainsi que d'autres paramètres forestiers et leur évolution au fil du temps. Votre recherche comprendra :
• Développer des modèles d'apprentissage profond pour l'analyse des séries chronologiques d'images satellitaires et l'adaptation des domaines
• Mise au point de modèles d'apprentissage approfondi pour la superrésolution (guide) de l'imagerie satellitaire historique
• Production d'estimations d'incertitude étalonnées pour toutes les sorties du modèle
• Des modèles de formation sur des sources de données hétérogènes (p. ex. Landsat, Sentinel-2, SPOT, Corona) et l'exploration de combinaisons multimodales de différentes sources de données. Liberté de la recherche et innovation méthodologique Le projet offre une grande liberté pour explorer les orientations méthodologiques impactées dans l'IA moderne, y compris: apprentissage autosupervisé, apprentissage multimodal, (guidé) super-résolution, estimation d'incertitude, régression de séries chronologiques. Nous visons des publications à fort impact à la fois dans des lieux d'apprentissage automatique (p. ex. CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, ICLR, NeurIPS) et des revues interdisciplinaires de pointe comme la télédétection de l'environnement, le Journal ISPRS et la durabilité de la nature. Pourquoi rejoindre ? Ces 2 postes de doctorat offrent :
• Devenez membre du laboratoire EcoVision, un endroit vibrant, excitant et amusant pour faire des recherches sur l'apprentissage profond pour les applications à l'écologie
• Collaboration étroite avec des groupes de recherche de premier plan dans les domaines de l'apprentissage automatique, de la vision informatique, de la science des données, de la télédétection et de l'interprétation historique des images de télédétection.
• Une occasion unique de combiner la recherche de pointe sur l'IA avec l'impact réel sur l'environnement pour un sujet de recherche encore complètement sous-exploré
• Accès à des archives d'images historiques à grande échelle - C'est pas vrai. Nous recherchons des candidats très motivés qui sont excités par le fait de repousser les limites de l'apprentissage automatique tout en contribuant à un impact environnemental significatif. Vous êtes curieux, rigoureux et aimez développer de nouvelles idées et des logiciels de recherche de haute qualité. Vous êtes à l'aise avec les problèmes difficiles et la collaboration entre les disciplines. Un candidat idéal aura :
• Un excellent diplôme de maîtrise (M.Sc. ou équivalent) en informatique, apprentissage automatique, science des données ou un domaine étroitement lié (p. ex., génie électrique, mathématiques appliquées)
• Une base solide en mathématiques et en apprentissage automatique
• Beaucoup d'expérience de programmation, de préférence en Python
• Forte expérience de l'apprentissage profond et de la vision informatique
• Intérêt pour l'application de méthodes avancées ML aux données écologiques et géospatiales
• La maîtrise de l'anglais (écrit et parlé) est requise Expérience de sujets tels que l'apprentissage autosupervisé, l'adaptation de domaine, l'apprentissage par transfert, l'apprentissage multimodal, l'estimation de l'incertitude est un plus - mais pas strictement nécessaire. Nous sommes déterminés à créer un environnement de recherche diversifié et inclusif. Nous encourageons les candidats de tous les horizons et nous souhaitons particulièrement la bienvenue à ceux qui ne répondent pas à tous les critères énumérés, mais qui apportent une forte motivation et un fort potentiel. - Oui. Nos employés bénéficient d'un large éventail d'offres attrayantes. Pour en savoir plus : https://www.uzh.ch/de/explore/work.html.

jobs.description:
The University of Zurich, Switzerland's largest university, offers a range of attractive positions in various subject areas and professional fields. With around 10,000 employees and currently 12 professional apprenticeship streams the University offers an inspiring working environment on cutting-edge research and top-class education. Put your talent and skills to work with us. Find out more about UZH as an employer!

Aufgaben:
• Aligning the established social production method with European System of Accounts (ESA 2010), adapting how it is applied and reported while preserving the underlying methodology.

• Mapping the social production categories to available SAKE data, assessing coverage, and conducting a gap analysis of categories not yet captured.

• Compiling and analysing the relevant Swiss data sources to produce the pilot account's first estimates.

• Building the account into a working statistical product, documented and reproducible so that it could be updated on a regular cycle by Switzerland and/or other nations wishing to adopt the approach.

• Co-authoring research and policy outputs, including a joint report on social production in Switzerland.

• Preparing a methodological report setting out options to extend category coverage, with recommendations for Switzerland and a generalisable approach that other national statistical offices could follow.

• Working in person within the National Accounts Division and liaising across FSO units to resolve questions of definition, derivation, and method.

• Maintaining reproducible workflows and documentation consistent with official statistics standards.

Anforderungen:
Essential:
• A doctorate in economics, applied statistics, or a quantitative social science or data science.

• Familiarity with national accounts concepts and conventions (ESA 2010), ideally including satellite accounting.

• Demonstrated skills in handling survey and time-use microdata.

• A strong command of time-series and index methods, including constant-price adjustment.

• A translational research orientation, comfortable working across an academic research team and a national statistical office and communicating with policy audiences.

• Working proficiency in German or French, together with English.
 Desirable:
• Experience with time-use surveys or unpaid-work modules in labour force surveys.

• A systems-oriented perspective on demographic change, the care economy, fiscal sustainability, and the intersection of market and non-market production.

• Experience working in or with a statistical office or national accounts setting.

• A record of peer-reviewed publication and technical reporting.
 What we offer:
• The opportunity to build the first social production satellite account established within a national statistical office, an innovation in national accounting with international reach.

• A role embedded in official statistics while contributing to frontier research, with training in the social production accounting method from the University of Sydney's Mental Wealth Initiative.

• Support through co-supervision across the three partners and connection to an international research and policy network spanning ageing, health, and economic measurement.

• Employment on University of Zurich terms, with salary set according to UZH and Canton of Zurich guidelines for postdoctoral researchers.

• A clearly defined three-year horizon to deliver a programme of work with direct policy relevance.
 Working arrangement and independence:
The position is employed by the University of Zurich Healthy Longevity Centre. Working time is divided between the FSO National Accounts Division in Neuchâtel, where the day-to-day work sits, and the UZH Centre for Healthy Longevity, with research supervision shared between the partners under a light joint-oversight arrangement. A clear separation is maintained between FSO-hosted research and official statistics, and no output carries the FSO's name without its approval. The underlying method is published and open.

Wir bieten:
Our employees benefit from a wide range of attractive offers. Find out more: https://www.uzh.ch/de/explore/work.html.

descriptionByLocale.it:
L'Università di Zurigo, la più grande università della Svizzera, offre una gamma di posizioni attraenti in varie aree tematiche e campi professionali. Con circa 10.000 dipendenti e attualmente 12 corsi di apprendistato professionale, l'Università offre un ambiente di lavoro stimolante sulla ricerca all'avanguardia e sull'istruzione di prima classe. Metti il tuo talento e le tue capacità per lavorare con noi. Scopri di più su UZH come datore di lavoro!

Aufgaben:
• Allineare il metodo di produzione sociale consolidato con il Sistema europeo dei conti (ESA 2010), adeguando il modo in cui viene applicato e segnalato mantenendo la metodologia sottostante.

• Mapping delle categorie di produzione sociale ai dati SAKE disponibili, valutazione della copertura e conduzione di un'analisi gap di categorie non ancora catturate.

• Compilare e analizzare le pertinenti fonti di dati svizzere per produrre le prime stime dell'account pilota.

• Costruire il conto in un prodotto statistico funzionante, documentato e riproducibile in modo che possa essere aggiornato su un ciclo regolare da parte della Svizzera e/o di altre nazioni che desiderano adottare l'approccio.

• Co-autorizzazione alla ricerca e ai risultati politici, compresa una relazione congiunta sulla produzione sociale in Svizzera.

• Preparare una relazione metodologica che definisce le opzioni per estendere la copertura delle categorie, con raccomandazioni per la Svizzera e un approccio generale che potrebbero seguire altri uffici statistici nazionali.

• Lavorare di persona all'interno della Divisione Conti Nazionale e legare tra le unità FSO per risolvere domande di definizione, derivazione e metodo.

• Mantenere flussi di lavoro riproducibili e documentazione coerente con gli standard statistici ufficiali.

Anforderungen:
Essenziale:
• Un dottorato in economia, statistiche applicate, o una scienza sociale o dati quantitativa.

• Familiarità con i concetti e le convenzioni di contabilità nazionale (ESA 2010), idealmente compresa la contabilità satellitare.

• Competenze dimostrate nella gestione dei microdati di indagine e uso del tempo.

• Un forte comando di serie temporali e metodi di indice, tra cui la regolazione costante dei prezzi.

• Un orientamento di ricerca traduttiva, un lavoro confortevole in un team di ricerca accademica e un ufficio statistico nazionale e comunicare con il pubblico politico.

• Competenza di lavoro in tedesco o francese, insieme con l'inglese.
Desiderabile:
• Esperienza con sondaggi sul tempo o moduli non retribuiti nelle indagini sulle forze di lavoro.

• Una prospettiva orientata ai sistemi sul cambiamento demografico, l'economia di cura, la sostenibilità fiscale, e l'intersezione del mercato e la produzione non di mercato.

• Esperienza di lavoro in o con un ufficio statistico o la definizione di conti nazionali.

• Un record di pubblicazione peer-reviewed e report tecnici.
Cosa offriamo:
• L'opportunità di costruire il primo conto satellite di produzione sociale stabilito all'interno di un ufficio statistico nazionale, un'innovazione nella contabilità nazionale con portata internazionale.

• Un ruolo incorporato nelle statistiche ufficiali, contribuendo alla ricerca di frontiera, con la formazione nel metodo di contabilità della produzione sociale dell'Università di Sydney Mental Wealth Initiative.

• Sostegno attraverso la co-supervisione attraverso i tre partner e il collegamento a una rete internazionale di ricerca e politica che prevede l'invecchiamento, la salute e la misurazione economica.

• Occupazione in termini di Università di Zurigo, con il set salariale secondo le linee guida UZH e Canton di Zurigo per i ricercatori post-dottori.

• Un orizzonte di tre anni chiaramente definito per fornire un programma di lavoro con rilevanza politica diretta.
Disposizione di lavoro e indipendenza:
La posizione è assunta dall'Università di Zurigo Healthy Longevity Centre. Il tempo di lavoro è diviso tra la FSO National Accounts Division di Neuchâtel, dove il lavoro di giorno per giorno siede, e l'UZH Centre for Healthy Longevity, con la supervisione della ricerca condivisa tra i partner sotto un leggero accordo di giunzione. Una chiara separazione è mantenuta tra la ricerca ospitata dall'FSO e le statistiche ufficiali, e nessuna uscita porta il nome dell'FSO senza la sua approvazione. Il metodo sottostante è pubblicato e aperto.

Wir bieten:
I nostri dipendenti beneficiano di una vasta gamma di offerte interessanti. Maggiori informazioni: https://www.uzh.ch/de/explore/work.html

Anforderungen:
Wesentlich:
• Ein Doktortitel in Wirtschaftswissenschaften, angewandter Statistik oder einer quantitativen Sozialwissenschaft oder Datenwissenschaft.

• Vertrautheit mit den Konzepten und Übereinkommen der Volkswirtschaftlichen Gesamtrechnungen (ESVG 2010), idealerweise einschließlich der Satellitenbuchhaltung.

• Nachgewiesene Fähigkeiten im Umgang mit Umfrage- und Zeit-Mikrodaten.

• Eine starke Beherrschung von Zeitreihen und Indexmethoden, einschließlich konstanter Preisanpassung.

• Eine translationale Forschungsorientierung, komfortables Arbeiten in einem akademischen Forschungsteam und einem nationalen statistischen Amt und die Kommunikation mit politischen Zielgruppen.

• Arbeitskenntnisse in Deutsch oder Französisch, zusammen mit Englisch.
Wünschenswert:
• Erfahrung mit Zeitnutzungserhebungen oder unbezahlten Arbeitsmodulen in Arbeitskräfteerhebungen.

• Eine systemorientierte Perspektive auf den demografischen Wandel, die Pflegewirtschaft, die steuerliche Nachhaltigkeit und die Schnittstelle zwischen Markt- und Nichtmarktproduktion.

• Erfahrung in oder mit einem statistischen Amt oder Volkswirtschaftlichen Gesamtrechnungen Einstellung.

• Eine Aufzeichnung von Peer-Review-Veröffentlichungen und technischer Berichterstattung.
Was wir anbieten:
• Die Möglichkeit, das erste soziale Produktionssatellitenkonto in einem nationalen statistischen Amt einzurichten, eine Innovation in der volkswirtschaftlichen Gesamtrechnung mit internationaler Reichweite.

• Eine Rolle, die in die offizielle Statistik eingebettet ist und gleichzeitig zur Pionierforschung beiträgt, mit einer Ausbildung in der Buchhaltungsmethode für soziale Produktion von der Mental Wealth Initiative der University of Sydney.

• Unterstützung durch Co-Supervision zwischen den drei Partnern und Verbindung zu einem internationalen Forschungs- und Politiknetzwerk, das Alterung, Gesundheit und wirtschaftliche Messungen umfasst.

• Beschäftigung zu Universitäts-Zürich-Bedingungen, wobei das Gehalt nach den Richtlinien der UZH und des Kantons Zürich für Postdoktoranden festgelegt wird.

• Ein klar definierter Dreijahreshorizont für ein Arbeitsprogramm mit direkter politischer Relevanz.
Arbeitsvereinbarung und Unabhängigkeit:
Die Stelle wird vom Healthy Longevity Centre der Universität Zürich angestellt. Die Arbeitszeit wird zwischen der volkswirtschaftlichen Gesamtrechnungsabteilung des FSO in Neuenburg, wo die tägliche Arbeit stattfindet, und dem UZH-Zentrum für gesunde Langlebigkeit aufgeteilt, wobei die Forschungsaufsicht zwischen den Partnern im Rahmen einer leichten gemeinsamen Aufsichtsvereinbarung geteilt wird. Es wird eine klare Trennung zwischen der von der FSO betriebenen Forschung und der offiziellen Statistik aufrechterhalten, und kein Output trägt den Namen der FSO ohne ihre Genehmigung. Die zugrunde liegende Methode ist veröffentlicht und offen.

Avec environ 10 000 employés et actuellement 12 filières d'apprentissage professionnel, l'Université offre un environnement de travail inspirant sur la recherche de pointe et l'éducation de haut niveau. Mettez votre talent et vos compétences au travail avec nous. En savoir plus sur UZH en tant qu'employeur!

Aufgaben:
• Alignement de la méthode de production sociale établie sur le Système européen de comptabilité (SEC 2010), en adaptant son application et sa déclaration tout en préservant la méthodologie sous-jacente.

• Cartographier les catégories de production sociale aux données SAKE disponibles, évaluer la couverture et effectuer une analyse des lacunes des catégories non encore saisies.

• Compiler et analyser les sources de données suisses pertinentes pour produire les premières estimations du compte pilote.

• Constituer un produit statistique fonctionnel, documenté et reproductible pour qu'il puisse être mis à jour sur un cycle régulier par la Suisse et/ou d'autres pays souhaitant adopter cette approche.

• Coauteur de travaux de recherche et de politiques, y compris un rapport conjoint sur la production sociale en Suisse.

• Élaboration d'un rapport méthodologique présentant des options pour étendre la couverture par catégorie, avec des recommandations pour la Suisse et une approche généralisable que d'autres offices nationaux de statistique pourraient suivre.

• Travailler en personne au sein de la Division de la comptabilité nationale et assurer la liaison entre les unités de l'OSF pour résoudre les questions de définition, de dérivation et de méthode.

• Maintenir les flux de travail et la documentation reproductibles conformément aux normes officielles de statistique.

- C'est pas vrai.
Essentiel:
• Doctorat en économie, en statistique appliquée, en sciences sociales quantitatives ou en sciences des données.

• Connaissance des concepts et conventions de la comptabilité nationale (ESA 2010), y compris idéalement la comptabilité par satellite.

• Compétences démontrées dans le traitement des microdonnées d'enquête et d'utilisation du temps.

• Une forte maîtrise des séries chronologiques et des méthodes d'indice, y compris l'ajustement des prix constants.

• Orientation en matière de recherche translationnelle, travail confortable au sein d'une équipe de recherche universitaire et d'un bureau national de la statistique et communication avec les publics politiques.

• Compétence professionnelle en allemand ou en français, avec l'anglais.
Désireux :
• Expérience des enquêtes sur l'emploi du temps ou des modules sur le travail non rémunéré dans les enquêtes sur les forces de travail.

• Une perspective systémique de l'évolution démographique, de l'économie des soins, de la viabilité budgétaire et de l'intersection de la production marchande et non marchande.

• Expérience de travail dans ou avec un bureau de statistique ou un établissement de comptabilité nationale.

• Un dossier de publication et de rapports techniques examinés par les pairs.
Ce que nous offrons:
• La possibilité de créer le premier compte satellite de production sociale établi au sein d'un bureau national de statistique, une innovation dans la comptabilité nationale à portée internationale.

• Un rôle ancré dans les statistiques officielles tout en contribuant à la recherche exploratoire, grâce à une formation à la méthode de comptabilité de la production sociale de l'Initiative sur la richesse mentale de l'Université de Sydney.

• Soutien par la co-surveillance entre les trois partenaires et connexion à un réseau international de recherche et de politiques couvrant le vieillissement, la santé et la mesure économique.

• Emploi à l'Université de Zurich, avec salaire fixé selon les directives de l'UZH et du canton de Zurich pour les chercheurs postdoctoraux.

• Un horizon de trois ans clairement défini pour l'exécution d'un programme de travail présentant une pertinence politique directe.
Modalités de travail et indépendance:
Ce poste est occupé par le Centre de longévité en santé de l'Université de Zurich. Le temps de travail est réparti entre la Division de la comptabilité nationale de l'OSF à Neuchâtel, où siège le travail quotidien, et le Centre pour la longévité en santé de l'USH, avec une supervision de la recherche partagée entre les partenaires dans le cadre d'un accord de vision conjointe léger. Une séparation claire est maintenue entre la recherche organisée par l'OSF et les statistiques officielles, et aucun résultat ne porte le nom de l'OSF sans son approbation. La méthode de base est publiée et ouverte.

• Capacità di cogliere rapidamente relazioni complesse e coordinare professionalmente diversi stakeholder
• Alto orientamento al servizio, affidabilità e discrezione

• Un team collegiale e impegnato con brevi percorsi decisionali
• Condizioni di lavoro moderne e forme flessibili di lavoro
• Un posto di lavoro attraente nel centro di Zurigo

Questa posizione offre la rara opportunità di contribuire a plasmare i processi decisionali e di controllo centrali in una delle più grandi università d'Europa da vicino. In un ambiente dinamico con diversi gruppi di stakeholder, si assume un importante coordinamento e funzione hub, creare trasparenza, garantire l'impegno e quindi dare un contributo significativo alla capacità della Direzione delle Finanze di agire. With around 10,000 employees and currently 12 professional profiles for learners, the university offers an inspiring working environment in cutting-edge research and education. Use your talent and skills with us. Find out more about UZH as an employer!

Tasks:
Board management and business preparation
• Coordination, quality assurance and timely submission of operations of the Directorate Finance for University Management, University Council and other central bodies
• Ensuring smooth management of committees, including requesting, reviewing and quality assurance of the basis for decision-making

Directorate Support and Administration
• Organization and coordination of Jour fixes, meetings, workshops and events of the Finance Directorate
• Ensure efficient management of appointments, documents, releases and pendants and support administrative processes

Quality assurance and further development
• Support in the preparation and quality assurance of reports, presentations and decision bases
• Participation in financial and organizational issues as well as in the further development of processes, templates and administrative processes
• Assistance to the staff for specific contracts and cross-cutting coordination tasks

Requirements
• Commercial training with several years of professional experience in comparable areas of responsibility
• Strong organisational skills and a structured, careful and independent working method
• Very good editorial skills and stylish German in word and writing, English is advantageous
• Ability to quickly grasp complex relationships and professionally coordinate different stakeholders
• High service orientation, reliability and discretion
• Very good knowledge of common office applications and digital collaboration tools

What you can look forward to
• A responsible and varied activity with a large organizational breadth
• A dynamic working environment with diverse contacts within central management bodies
• The opportunity to actively shape central processes and business of the university
• A collegial and committed team with short decision paths
• Modern working conditions and flexible forms of work
• An attractive workplace in the center of Zurich

Why this job is particularly exciting
This position offers the rare opportunity to help shape central decision-making and control processes at one of the largest universities in Europe up close. jobs.description:
The University of Zurich, Switzerland's largest university, offers a range of attractive positions in various subject areas and professional fields. With around 10,000 employees and currently 12 professional apprenticeship streams the University offers an inspiring working environment on cutting-edge research and top-class education. Put your talent and skills to work with us. Find out more about UZH as an employer!

Aufgaben:
The successful candidate will take on responsibilities that approximately follow the trajectory below.
• Cloning, expression, purification, and activity characterization for our target enzyme,

• Chemical synthesis of substrates and assay probes,

• Assay development for screening enzymatic activity,

• Creation and high-throughput screening of DNA libraries,

• NGS and computational analysis of variants,

• Scripting in python for data analysis,

• Characterization of key enzyme variants, and

• Combining mechanistic enzymology and computation to understand the effects of mutations on catalysis.

Although no candidate will be expected to have experience in all the fields above prior to joining, the project is interdisciplinary. Thus, an enthusiasm and capacity to become proficient in all of these techniques is essential.

Additionally, the student will be responsible for academic and organizational duties, including
• serving as a teaching assistant for introductory chemistry courses,

• participating in group meetings and departmental seminars,

• fulfilling group responsibilities (equipment and organizational responsibilities), and

• completing PhD requirements for the chemistry graduate school program.

Anforderungen:
Essential:
• A highly motivated student with an MS degree in chemistry, biochemistry, or related field

• Ability to logically design rigorous experiments, including control experiments

• Scientific integrity

• Proactive about planning

• Capable of integrating feedback efficiently

• Capable of working in a highly interdisciplinary project

• Experience with cloning, protein expression, and protein purification

• Experience with chemical synthesis

• Willingness and ability to learn Python scripting

• Enthusiastic about learning and applying new techniques

• Enthusiastic about working on an interdisciplinary research project

• Excellent communications skills in English (spoken and written) are essential

• Conscientious and inclusive working style

• Ability to positively contribute to a supportive working environment

Highly desirable, one or more of the following:
• Enzyme assay development

• Protein engineering

• Comfort with light scripting for data analysis

Our employees benefit from a wide range of attractive offers. Find out more: https://www.uzh.ch/de/explore/work.html.

• Teilnahme an Gruppensitzungen und Abteilungsseminaren,

• Abschluss der PhD-Anforderungen für die Chemie Graduiertenschule Programm.

Wesentlich:
• Ein hoch motivierter Student mit einem MS-Abschluss in Chemie, Biochemie oder verwandten Bereichen

• Fähigkeit, logisch strenge Experimente zu entwerfen, einschließlich Kontrollexperimente

• Wissenschaftliche Integrität

• Proaktive Planung

• Fähigkeit, Feedback effizient zu integrieren

• Fähigkeit, in einem hoch interdisziplinären Projekt zu arbeiten

• Erfahrung mit Klonen, Proteinexpression und Proteinreinigung

• Erfahrung mit chemischer Synthese

• Bereitschaft und Fähigkeit, Python-Scripting zu lernen

• Begeistert über das Erlernen und Anwenden neuer Techniken

• Begeistert über die Arbeit an einem interdisziplinären Forschungsprojekt

• Hervorragende Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Englisch (gesprochen und geschrieben) sind unerlässlich

• Gewissenhafter und inklusiver Arbeitsstil

• Fähigkeit, positiv zu einem unterstützenden Arbeitsumfeld beizutragen

Sehr wünschenswert, eine oder mehrere der folgenden Eigenschaften:
• Entwicklung von Enzymassays

• Protein Engineering

• Komfort mit Light Scripting für die Datenanalyse

Con circa 10.000 dipendenti e attualmente 12 profili professionali per gli studenti, l'università offre un ambiente di lavoro stimolante nella ricerca e nell'istruzione all'avanguardia. Usa il tuo talento e le tue abilità con noi. Scopri di più su UZH come datore di lavoro!

Compiti:
• Controllo del business quotidiano del reparto Mass Spectrometry: sviluppi dei metodi, analisi e valutazioni di routine, supervisione dell'area Open Access e formazione/supporto degli utenti

• Sostenere le attività di ricerca del Dipartimento di Spettrometria di Massa: esame di campioni complessi, consulenza di progetto tecnico e supporto nell'interpretazione dei dati

• Supporto e manutenzione di attrezzature e infrastrutture: lavori di manutenzione, riparazioni, tarature di massa, supporto di magazzino di pezzi di ricambio e comunicazione con produttori e tecnici di servizio: all'interno

• Manutenzione di database per il funzionamento del servizio e la manutenzione del server di accesso aperto "Chromeleon"

• Supporto del sito web della nuova piattaforma tecnologica (www.cumolas.ch)

Requisiti
• Insegnamento come tecnico di laboratorio: nel campo della chimica EFZ, oltre ad un'ulteriore formazione completa come scienza naturale: il tecnico di laboratorio: in HFP (o equivalente) o un grado completato (FH) nel campo della chimica (analitica) (o equivalente)

• almeno 5 anni di esperienza professionale in LC/GC-MS e preparazione del campione

• Buona conoscenza della cromatografia, spettrometria di massa ad alta risoluzione, quantificazione e elaborazione dei dati

• Buona conoscenza delle proprietà molecolari e delle riattivazione

• conoscenza molto buona di tedesco e inglese in parola e scrittura

• conoscenza IT molto buona: esperienza nel trattare con computer Windows, software di spettrometria di massa e database (ad esempio Chromeleon)

• Alto grado di indipendenza, flessibilità e resilienza

• metodo di lavoro estremamente responsabile, affidabile e orientato alla soluzione

Offriamo:
I nostri dipendenti beneficiano di offerte diverse e attraenti. Per saperne di più: https://www.uzh.ch/en/explore/work.html

jobs.description:
The University of Zurich, Switzerland's largest university, offers a range of attractive positions in various subject areas and professional fields. With around 10,000 employees and currently 12 professional apprenticeship streams the University offers an inspiring working environment on cutting-edge research and top-class education. Put your talent and skills to work with us. Find out more about UZH as an employer!

Aufgaben:
• to conduct research and publish in top-tier journals in areas of organizational behavior and/or human resource management, with a special focus on leader self-disclosure of flaws at work

• to assist with the development and delivery of organizational behavior, human resource management and/or general management courses, for undergraduate, graduate and/or executive participants

• to provide supervision for undergraduate and graduate students

• as part of the team in the Center for Leadership in the Future of Work, to contribute to the center, particularly with regard to science communication efforts in the Center, as a leading platform for rigorous research, forward-looking teaching, effective outreach, and organizational and societal impact

Anforderungen:
• an enthusiasm for the topic of leadership and an interest in disclosure of flaws at work

• an excellent Masters degree or its equivalent in Business or Psychology or neighboring fields, including success-fully completed courses in organizational behavior or organizational/industrial psychology or social psychology

• excellent oral and written English, as evidenced, for non-native speakers, in relevant test scores (e.g., TOEFL), stays abroad and/or a Masters thesis written in English; German language skills are not needed (taking German classes is an option for those who want to)

• a very good understanding of quantitative methods, including study design and statistical analyses, and a very good command of relevant software packages, such as R, Mplus, Stata, and/or SPSS

• experience with qualitative/mixed methods, or curiosity and enthusiasm for learning about these methods, is a plus

• good technical skills, including a very good command of Microsoft office software; any coding skills are a plus

• a strong interest in research and, ideally, some relevant experience, for example, as a research assistant during your previous studies

• a collaborative spirit and energy for working in a team, as well as curiosity, self-reliance, and initiative-taking

• an interest in science communication, with a focus on research that has practical impact

Today, leaders are encouraged to be open about their personal flaws (i.e., negative personal characteristics) at work. For example, an award-winning Harvard Business Review article advises business leaders to “show us who they are–warts and all,” like admitting being irritable, disorganized, or shy. Supporting this idea, self-disclosure theory has long suggested that revealing aspects of one's self to others builds stronger connections with them. Similarly, the literature on authenticity suggests that leaders who are more open and transparent are more effec-tive. These examples from science and practice all suggest that leaders who let their guard down and openly show their more negative sides can be more successful.

However, this optimistic view takes a one-size-fits-all approach that neglects aspects of human diversity, including leader attributes like gender, age, and race. This research project thus examines how leader diversity influences self-disclosure of flaws in the workplace. For members of social groups that are already underrepresented in leadership positions and face stereotypes in leadership (e.g., women), being open about certain personal flaws could present a risk for leaders rather than an advantage (e.g., constituting a social norm violation that prompts backlash).

The proposed research has meaningful societal implications as leadership is becoming more diverse and more personal. The insights from this research inform dialogues among practitioners and the public that, right now, reinforce the notion that leaders should be their true selves at work. Results will help to unpack whether openly disclosing personal flaws at work is a privilege that only some leaders may enjoy. Already, women and other un-derrepresented groups are disadvantaged when it comes to the pursuit of leadership positions. Trends that en-courage leaders to be open about personal flaws may risk exacerbating these differences – or alternatively, may hold promise in ameliorating them.

• eccellente inglese orale e scritto, come evidenziato, per i non madrelingua, nei punteggi di test rilevanti (ad esempio, TOEFL), rimane all'estero e/o una tesi di Masters scritta in inglese; non sono necessarie competenze linguistiche tedesche (prendere classi tedesche è un'opzione per coloro che vogliono)

• una buona comprensione dei metodi quantitativi, tra cui la progettazione di studi e analisi statistiche, e un ottimo comando di pacchetti software rilevanti, come R, Mplus, Stata e/o SPSS

• esperienza con metodi qualitativi / mescolati, o la curiosità e l'entusiasmo per conoscere questi metodi, è un plus

• buone competenze tecniche, tra cui un ottimo comando del software per ufficio Microsoft; qualsiasi abilità di codifica sono un plus

• un forte interesse per la ricerca e, idealmente, qualche esperienza rilevante, per esempio, come assistente di ricerca durante i tuoi studi precedenti

• uno spirito collaborativo e l'energia per lavorare in un team, così come la curiosità, l'autostima e l'imprenditoria

• un interesse per la comunicazione scientifica, con un focus sulla ricerca che ha un impatto pratico

Oggi, i leader sono incoraggiati ad essere aperti sui loro difetti personali (cioè, le caratteristiche personali negative) al lavoro. Ad esempio, un articolo di Harvard Business Review premiato consiglia ai leader di business di “mostrare a noi chi sono – si avverte e tutto,” come ammettere di essere irritabile, disorganizzato, o timido. Sostenere questa idea, la teoria dell'auto-disclosure ha a lungo suggerito che rivelare gli aspetti del proprio sé agli altri costruisce legami più forti con loro. Allo stesso modo, la letteratura sull'autenticità suggerisce che i leader più aperti e trasparenti sono più effet-tivi. Questi esempi di scienza e pratica suggeriscono tutti che i leader che hanno lasciato la loro guardia giù e mostrare apertamente i loro lati più negativi possono essere più successo.

Tuttavia, questa visione ottimista prende un approccio unico-dimensione-fits-all che trascura aspetti della diversità umana, tra cui attributi leader come il sesso, l'età e la razza. Questo progetto di ricerca esamina così come la diversità leader influenza l'auto-disclosure dei difetti sul posto di lavoro. Per i membri di gruppi sociali che sono già sottorappresentati in posizioni di leadership e facciano stereotipi in leadership (ad esempio, le donne), essere aperti su alcuni difetti personali potrebbe presentare un rischio per i leader piuttosto che un vantaggio (ad esempio, costituendo una violazione della norma sociale che spinge indietro).

La ricerca proposta ha implicazioni sociali significative in quanto la leadership sta diventando più diversificata e più personale. Le intuizioni di questa ricerca informano i dialoghi tra i praticanti e il pubblico che, in questo momento, rafforzano la nozione che i leader dovrebbero essere loro veri se stessi al lavoro. I risultati aiuteranno a disfare i bagagli se rivelare apertamente i difetti personali al lavoro è un privilegio che solo alcuni leader possono godere. Già, le donne e altri gruppi non rappresentati sono svantaggiati quando si tratta di perseguire posizioni di leadership. Le tendenze che i leader in-courage per essere aperti sui difetti personali possono rischiare di aggravare queste differenze – o in alternativa, possono mantenere la promessa in ameliorazione loro.

descriptionByLocale.en:
The University of Zurich, Switzerland's largest university, offers a range of attractive positions in various subject areas and professional fields. With around 10,000 employees and currently 12 professional apprenticeship streams the University offers an inspiring working environment on cutting-edge research and top-class education. Put your talent and skills to work with us. Find out more about UZH as an employer!

Aufgaben:
• to conduct research and publish in top-tier journals in areas of organizational behavior and/or human resource management, with a special focus on leader self-disclosure of flaws at work

• to assist with the development and delivery of organizational behavior, human resource management and/or general management courses, for undergraduate, graduate and/or executive participants

• to provide supervision for undergraduate and graduate students

• as part of the team in the Center for Leadership in the Future of Work, to contribute to the center, particularly with regard to science communication efforts in the Center, as a leading platform for rigorous research, forward-looking teaching, effective outreach, and organizational and societal impact

Anforderungen:
• an enthusiasm for the topic of leadership and an interest in disclosure of flaws at work

• an excellent Masters degree or its equivalent in Business or Psychology or neighboring fields, including success-fully completed courses in organizational behavior or organizational/industrial psychology or social psychology

• excellent oral and written English, as evidenced, for non-native speakers, in relevant test scores (e.g., TOEFL), stays abroad and/or a Masters thesis written in English; German language skills are not needed (taking German classes is an option for those who want to)

• a very good understanding of quantitative methods, including study design and statistical analyses, and a very good command of relevant software packages, such as R, Mplus, Stata, and/or SPSS

• experience with qualitative/mixed methods, or curiosity and enthusiasm for learning about these methods, is a plus

• good technical skills, including a very good command of Microsoft office software; any coding skills are a plus

• a strong interest in research and, ideally, some relevant experience, for example, as a research assistant during your previous studies

• a collaborative spirit and energy for working in a team, as well as curiosity, self-reliance, and initiative-taking

• an interest in science communication, with a focus on research that has practical impact

Today, leaders are encouraged to be open about their personal flaws (i.e., negative personal characteristics) at work. For example, an award-winning Harvard Business Review article advises business leaders to “show us who they are–warts and all,” like admitting being irritable, disorganized, or shy. Supporting this idea, self-disclosure theory has long suggested that revealing aspects of one's self to others builds stronger connections with them. Similarly, the literature on authenticity suggests that leaders who are more open and transparent are more effec-tive. These examples from science and practice all suggest that leaders who let their guard down and openly show their more negative sides can be more successful.

However, this optimistic view takes a one-size-fits-all approach that neglects aspects of human diversity, including leader attributes like gender, age, and race. This research project thus examines how leader diversity influences self-disclosure of flaws in the workplace. For members of social groups that are already underrepresented in leadership positions and face stereotypes in leadership (e.g., women), being open about certain personal flaws could present a risk for leaders rather than an advantage (e.g., constituting a social norm violation that prompts backlash).

The proposed research has meaningful societal implications as leadership is becoming more diverse and more personal. The insights from this research inform dialogues among practitioners and the public that, right now, reinforce the notion that leaders should be their true selves at work. Results will help to unpack whether openly disclosing personal flaws at work is a privilege that only some leaders may enjoy. Already, women and other un-derrepresented groups are disadvantaged when it comes to the pursuit of leadership positions. Trends that en-courage leaders to be open about personal flaws may risk exacerbating these differences – or alternatively, may hold promise in ameliorating them.

• Ausgezeichnetes mündliches und schriftliches Englisch, wie nachgewiesen, für Nicht-Muttersprachler, in relevanten Testergebnissen (z. B. TOEFL), Auslandsaufenthalten und / oder einer in englischer Sprache verfassten Masterarbeit; Deutschkenntnisse sind nicht erforderlich (Deutschunterricht ist eine Option für diejenigen, die dies wünschen)

• ein sehr gutes Verständnis der quantitativen Methoden, einschließlich Studiendesign und statistische Analysen und eine sehr gute Beherrschung der relevanten Softwarepakete, wie R, Mplus, Stata und / oder SPSS

• Erfahrung mit qualitativen / gemischten Methoden oder Neugier und Begeisterung für das Lernen über diese Methoden ist ein Plus

• gute technische Fähigkeiten, einschließlich einer sehr guten Beherrschung der Microsoft Office-Software; alle Programmierkenntnisse sind ein Plus

• ein kooperativer Geist und Energie für die Arbeit in einem Team, sowie Neugier, Eigenständigkeit und Initiative

• Interesse an Wissenschaftskommunikation, mit Fokus auf Forschung, die praktische Auswirkungen hat

Heute werden Führungskräfte ermutigt, offen über ihre persönlichen Fehler (dh negative persönliche Eigenschaften) bei der Arbeit zu sein. Zum Beispiel rät ein preisgekrönter Harvard Business Review-Artikel Wirtschaftsführern, "uns zu zeigen, wer sie sind - Warzen und alle", wie zuzugeben, gereizt, unorganisiert oder schüchtern zu sein. Die Theorie der Selbstoffenlegung, die diese Idee unterstützt, hat lange vorgeschlagen, dass die Enthüllung von Aspekten des eigenen Selbst für andere stärkere Verbindungen mit ihnen aufbaut. In ähnlicher Weise legt die Literatur über Authentizität nahe, dass Führungskräfte, die offener und transparenter sind, effektiver sind. Diese Beispiele aus Wissenschaft und Praxis deuten alle darauf hin, dass Führungskräfte, die ihre Wachsamkeit aufgeben und offen ihre negativeren Seiten zeigen, erfolgreicher sein können.

Diese optimistische Sichtweise verfolgt jedoch einen einheitlichen Ansatz, der Aspekte der menschlichen Vielfalt vernachlässigt, einschließlich Führungsmerkmale wie Geschlecht, Alter und Rasse. In diesem Forschungsprojekt wird daher untersucht, wie Führungsdiversität die Selbstaufklärung von Fehlern am Arbeitsplatz beeinflusst. Für Mitglieder sozialer Gruppen, die in Führungspositionen bereits unterrepräsentiert sind und in Führungspositionen Stereotypen ausgesetzt sind (z. B. Frauen), könnte die Offenheit gegenüber bestimmten persönlichen Fehlern eher ein Risiko für Führungskräfte als einen Vorteil darstellen (z. B. eine Verletzung der sozialen Norm, die zu Rückschlägen führt).

Die vorgeschlagene Forschung hat bedeutende gesellschaftliche Implikationen, da die Führung vielfältiger und persönlicher wird. Die Erkenntnisse aus dieser Forschung informieren Dialoge zwischen Praktizierenden und der Öffentlichkeit, die derzeit die Vorstellung verstärken, dass Führungskräfte ihr wahres Selbst bei der Arbeit sein sollten. Die Ergebnisse werden dazu beitragen, herauszufinden, ob die offene Offenlegung persönlicher Mängel bei der Arbeit ein Privileg ist, das nur einige Führungskräfte genießen können. Bereits jetzt sind Frauen und andere nicht vertretene Gruppen benachteiligt, wenn es um die Ausübung von Führungspositionen geht. Trends, die Führungskräfte ermutigen, offen über persönliche Fehler zu sein, können riskieren, diese Unterschiede zu verschärfen - oder alternativ dazu, sie zu verbessern.

Aujourd'hui, les dirigeants sont encouragés à être ouverts sur leurs défauts personnels (c'est-à-dire leurs caractéristiques personnelles négatives) au travail. En soutenant cette idée, la théorie de l'autodivulgation a longtemps suggéré que révéler des aspects de soi à d'autres renforce les liens avec eux. De même, la littérature sur l'authenticité suggère que les leaders plus ouverts et transparents sont plus efficaces. Ces exemples tirés de la science et de la pratique donnent à penser que les dirigeants qui laissent tomber leur garde et montrent ouvertement leurs côtés les plus négatifs peuvent avoir plus de succès.

Toutefois, cette vision optimiste adopte une approche unique qui néglige certains aspects de la diversité humaine, y compris les attributs de leader comme le sexe, l'âge et la race. Ce projet de recherche examine donc l'influence de la diversité des leaders sur la divulgation des défauts en milieu de travail. Pour les membres de groupes sociaux qui sont déjà sous-représentés dans les postes de direction et qui sont confrontés à des stéréotypes dans les postes de direction (p. ex., les femmes), l'ouverture sur certains défauts personnels pourrait présenter un risque pour les dirigeants plutôt qu'un avantage (p. ex., constituer une violation des normes sociales qui provoque des contrecoups).

La recherche proposée a des répercussions sociales significatives à mesure que le leadership devient plus diversifié et plus personnel. Les conclusions de cette recherche éclairent les dialogues entre les praticiens et le public qui, à l'heure actuelle, renforcent l'idée que les dirigeants doivent être eux-mêmes véritables au travail. Les résultats aideront à déterminer si la divulgation ouverte de défauts personnels au travail est un privilège que seuls certains dirigeants peuvent apprécier. Déjà, les femmes et d'autres groupes non représentés sont désavantagés en ce qui concerne la poursuite de postes de direction. Les tendances qui incitent les dirigeants à s'ouvrir au sujet des défauts personnels risquent d'exacerber ces différences – ou encore de les améliorer.

• Betreuung und Koordination bestehender Programme der UZH International Summer Schools (UZHISS)

• Mitwirkung bei der Weiterentwicklung der UZHISS

• Durchführung des Rekrutierungsprozesses sowie Kommunikation mit internationalen Bewerbenden, Partneruniversitäten sowie UZH-Studierenden

• Vermarktung und Positionierung der UZHISS auf relevanten Kommunikations- und Marketingplattformen

• Planung und Umsetzung von Veranstaltungen im Rahmen des Social Programs

• Mitverantwortung der finanziellen Verwaltung der Programme

• Mitarbeit bei administrativen Aufgaben im Bereich Studierendenmobilität und der Abteilung
 Hinweis zur Arbeitszeit:
Während der Rekrutierungszeit für die UZHISS-Programme von März bis Juni ist eine kurze Antwortzeit für den Erfolg essenziell. Wir erwarten daher die Bereitschaft, in dieser Zeit bei Bedarf mehr als 60% zu arbeiten. Während der Durchführung der Summer Schools im Juli und ggf. August liegt das Arbeitspensum bei 100%. Dafür gibt es auch weniger arbeitsintensive Monate, sodass die Jahresarbeitszeit im Schnitt 65% beträgt.

Anforderungen:
Sie arbeiten selbstständig, strukturiert und präzis und schätzen die Zusammenarbeit im Team. Sie verfügen über ein hohes Verantwortungs- und Qualitätsbewusstsein und behalten auch bei vielfältigen Aufgaben und unter Zeitdruck den Überblick. Die inhaltliche und zeitliche Flexibilität dieser Stelle kommt Ihnen entgegen. Sie kommunizieren stilsicher mit unterschiedlichen Anspruchsgruppen innerhalb und ausserhalb der UZH. Der Kontakt mit Menschen aus verschiedenen kulturellen Kontexten bereitet Ihnen Freude. Zudem treten Sie vor grösserem Zielpublikum sicher auf.
• Abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium (auf Bachelor- oder Master-Stufe)

• Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in administrativen Arbeiten; Erfahrung in Marketing von Vorteil

• Exzellente Englischkenntnisse, stilsicheres Deutsch in Wort und Schrift

• Hohe Flexibilität; Bereitschaft, während der UZHISS 100% zu arbeiten

• Sehr gute MS Office-Anwenderkenntnisse; ausgeprägte digitale Kompetenz und schnelle Auffassungsgabe bei der Anwendung neuer Technologien

• Kenntnisse über das universitäre Umfeld, Summer Schools sowie der UZH von Vorteil

jobs.description:
The University of Zurich offers a wide range of attractive positions in various subject areas and professional fields. With around 10,000 employees and 12 professional apprenticeship streams, Switzerland's largest university provides an inspiring working environment at the vanguard of research and education. Find out more about UZH as an employer!

Aufgaben:
You are a dynamic and integrative individual with extensive expertise in proton radiation therapy, including the clinical care of patients. You hold a specialist qualification in radiation oncology/radiotherapy or an equivalent qualification and you have comprehensive clinical experience across the entire field of radiation oncology, including pediatric oncology, as well as clinical and scientific expertise in particle therapy and high-precision radiation therapy. A habilitation or an equivalent academic qualification is required. You have published in relevant scientific journals and possess experience in leading research projects, successfully acquiring competitive third-party funding as a principal investigator, as well as enthusiasm in teaching students and fostering early-career academics. Your participatory and goal-oriented leadership approach ensures an attractive working environment for academic and clinical specialists.

Anforderungen:
The University of Zurich is a highly attractive institution for cutting edge research with plenty of opportunities for collaborations across its faculties and with its university hospitals. The successful candidate is expected to strengthen the existing as well as new collaborations between the university hospitals and the PSI.

The PSI is the largest research institute for natural and engineering sciences in Switzerland. It conducts cutting-edge research in the fields of future technologies, energy and climate, health innovation, and the fundamentals of nature. Through both basic and applied research, PSI works on sustainable solutions to key challenges facing society, science, and industry. The Center for Proton Therapy combines clinical patient care with cutting edge scientific research. Thanks to its strong national network and its active international research activities, it enjoys an excellent global reputation.

German language skills at level B2 of the common European framework of reference for languages should be available or must be acquired within a reasonable period of time.

The University of Zurich and the Paul Scherrer Institute are equal opportunities employers and in particular strive to increase the percentage of women in leading positions. Therefore, qualified female researchers are encouraged to apply.

Both institutions see researchers as modern leadership personalities who conduct excellent research - taking into account the Open Science principles - through their own research projects, promote excellent young researchers and who help to shape a forward-looking university with innovative research-based teaching.

Wir bieten:
Our employees benefit from a wide range of attractive offers .

Il candidato di successo dovrebbe rafforzare le collaborazioni esistenti e nuove tra gli ospedali universitari e il PSI.

Attraverso la ricerca di base e applicata, PSI lavora su soluzioni sostenibili per affrontare le sfide chiave della società, della scienza e dell'industria. Eine Habilitation oder eine gleichwertige akademische Qualifikation ist erforderlich. Sie haben in relevanten wissenschaftlichen Zeitschriften veröffentlicht und verfügen über Erfahrung in der Leitung von Forschungsprojekten, den erfolgreichen Erwerb wettbewerbsfähiger Drittmittel als Principal Investigator sowie Begeisterung für die Lehre von Studenten und die Förderung von Nachwuchswissenschaftlern. Es betreibt Spitzenforschung in den Bereichen Zukunftstechnologien, Energie und Klima, Gesundheitsinnovation und die Grundlagen der Natur. Durch Grundlagenforschung und angewandte Forschung arbeitet das PSI an nachhaltigen Lösungen für die wichtigsten Herausforderungen von Gesellschaft, Wissenschaft und Industrie. jobs.description:
The University of Zurich, Switzerland's largest university, offers a range of attractive positions in various subject areas and professional fields. With around 10,000 employees and currently 12 professional apprenticeship streams the University offers an inspiring working environment on cutting-edge research and top-class education. Put your talent and skills to work with us. Find out more about UZH as an employer!

Aufgaben:
Specific project goals:
• Generate CAR immune cell communities, comprising mixtures of engineered T cells, NK cells, monocytes, and additional cell types, using sophisticated in vitro and in vivo engineering platforms.

• Identify co-factors that boost CAR immune cell function using cutting-edge screening platforms.

• Investigate anti-tumor activity and immune-cancer-cell environmental crosstalk in vitro and in vivo using sophisticated disease models (organoids, slice cultures, patient-derived samples, mouse models) and modern technologies including flow cytometry, multiplexed imaging, spatial transcriptomics/proteomics and single-cell profiling.

• Analyze patient samples from an accompanying clinical trial evaluating CAR immune cell communities.

Anforderungen:
• Intellectual curiosity, creativity and a proactive approach to problem-solving

• Motivation to contribute to a project with direct patient impact

• PhD in immunology, computational immunology, cell/molecular/cancer biology, bioengineering, biomedical sciences, or a related field

• Experience with immune cell engineering, cellular immunotherapy, and/or advanced in vitro/in vivo disease models is highly desirable

• Familiarity with single-cell and/or spatial technologies is a plus

• Strong publication record demonstrating scientific productivity

• Excellent communication skills and the ability to thrive in an interdisciplinary team

Our employees benefit from a wide range of attractive offers. Find out more: https://www.uzh.ch/de/explore/work.html.

• Identificare i cofattori che aumentano la funzione delle cellule immunitarie CAR utilizzando piattaforme di screening all'avanguardia.

jobs.description:
The University of Zurich, Switzerland's largest university, offers a range of attractive positions in various subject areas and professional fields. With around 10,000 employees and currently 12 professional apprenticeship streams the University offers an inspiring working environment on cutting-edge research and top-class education. Put your talent and skills to work with us. Find out more about UZH as an employer!

Aufgaben:
• Plan, coordinate and conduct in vivo studies in mouse models of genetic liver disease required for the initiation of clinical trials.

• Administer genome-editing therapeutics and other test substances using relevant routes of delivery.

• Perform animal monitoring, blood and tissue collection, necropsies, organ harvesting and downstream sample processing.

• Perform molecular and cellular biology experiments, including mammalian cell culture, DNA and RNA isolation, PCR/qPCR, cloning and preparation of samples for sequencing.

• Analyse, interpret and document experimental results and contribute to the optimisation of experimental protocols.

• Maintain accurate records and ensure that all animal experiments are conducted in accordance with approved protocols and Swiss animal-welfare regulations.

• Collaborate closely with scientists, students and external project partners across several parallel research projects.

Anforderungen:
• BSc or MSc in molecular biology, biotechnology, biomedicine, veterinary medicine, pharmaceutical sciences or a related discipline.

• Substantial hands-on experience conducting experiments with mice is essential.

• Candidates should be confident in animal handling and in relevant experimental procedures such as dosing/injections, monitoring, blood sampling, tissue collection and necropsy.

• Strong practical experience in molecular and cellular biology (cloning, cell culture) and careful handling of biological samples.

• Experience with CRISPR genome editing, RNA therapeutics, lipid nanoparticles, viral vectors, liver biology or metabolic disease models is an advantage but not required.

• Ability to organise and conduct experiments independently, troubleshoot procedures and contribute effectively to multiple projects.

• A highly reliable, precise and collaborative working style, with strong attention to animal welfare and experimental documentation.

• Good written and spoken English.

Our employees benefit from a wide range of attractive offers. Find out more: https://www.uzh.ch/de/explore/work.html.

• Fähigkeit, Experimente unabhängig zu organisieren und durchzuführen, Verfahren zu beheben und effektiv zu mehreren Projekten beizutragen.

As the largest university in Switzerland, the University of Zurich offers a large number of attractive positions in various disciplines and professional fields. With around 10,000 employees and currently 12 professional profiles for learners, the university offers an inspiring working environment in cutting-edge research and education. Use your talent and skills with us. Find out more about UZH as an employer!

Tasks:
They support researchers in the field of life sciences in cooperation with industry and in the commercial implementation of their research results. This includes in particular:
• Drawing up, reviewing and negotiating research contracts with domestic and foreign partners:

• Evaluation of inventions with regard to patentability and commercial potential

• Coordination of patent applications in cooperation with patent attorneys:

• Support for the transfer and economic exploitation of technologies

• Preparation of license agreements and conduct negotiations until the conclusion of the contract

Requirements
They have a university degree in the field of life sciences, e.g. biology, biochemistry, pharmacy or medicine. You have several years of professional experience in the private sector in a customer-oriented task. Now you want to take the next development step.
In addition, bring with you:

• Interested in dealing in depth with contracts as well as scientific, technical and legal issues

• Independent, initiative and structured working methods

• Ability to capture and communicate complex issues in an understandable way

• Stylistic German and very good English in word and writing

• Initial experience with patents, licenses and research contracts would be a plus.

jobs.description:
The University of Zurich, Switzerland's largest university, offers a range of attractive positions in various subject areas and professional fields. With around 10,000 employees and currently 12 professional apprenticeship streams the University offers an inspiring working environment on cutting-edge research and top-class education. Put your talent and skills to work with us. Find out more about UZH as an employer!

Aufgaben:
• Co-design and implement a VR testbed for FOG triggering, including the design and standardization of virtual scenarios (e.g., turning triggers, visual underload, and dual-task paradigms).

• Collaborate with clinicians to test and validate scenarios in clinical settings.

• Use biomarkers for FOG phenotyping by collecting and analyzing oculography, muscle activity (EMG), and motion data during VR-triggered FOG assessments.

• Integrate VR, oculography, EMG, and motion capture into a unified clinical assessment tool.

Anforderungen:
• Excellent Bachelor's or Master's degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Biomedical Engineering, or a closely related field.

• Strong programming skills in C#, Unity, and Python.

• Demonstrated experience in recording and analyzing multimodal sensor data.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey complex information clearly to both - expert and non-expert audiences.

• Excellent English communication skills; proficiency in German is an advantage.

• Prior experience in neuroscience, clinical research, and patient interaction is a plus.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, combined with scientific rigor and intellectual curiosity to uncover meaningful insights.

• Creative, self-motivated, and able to thrive in a highly collaborative and interdisciplinary environment.

jobs.description:
The University of Zurich, Switzerland's largest university, offers a range of attractive positions in various subject areas and professional fields. With around 10,000 employees and currently 12 professional apprenticeship streams the University offers an inspiring working environment on cutting-edge research and top-class education. Put your talent and skills to work with us. Find out more about UZH as an employer!

Aufgaben:
The selected candidate will take a central role in the group's in vitro and in vivo drug-discovery programme. Responsibilities include: (i) setting up in vitro and in vivo blood brain barrier models in the lab and test drug candidates in such models using ELISA or LC-MS etc; (ii) processing brain tissue for histological and biochemical assays, including sectioning (cryostat/microtome), immunohistochemistry and immunofluorescence staining, fluorescence/confocal imaging, quantitative large-batch image analysis, ELISA and western blot assays for brain homogenates; and (iii) supporting cell-based assays, including mammalian cell culture, microglial phagocytosis assays and flow cytometry (FACS). The candidate will also contribute to standard biochemical read-outs (e.g. ELISA, Western blot) and to the careful documentation of experimental data.

Anforderungen:
• PhD degree in biology, neuroscience, biomedicine or a related field. Experience in drug discovery in neurodegeneration is a plus.

• Hands-on experience with blood brain barrier research including setting up in vitro and in vivo models, quantitative analysis of drug penetration. Experience with LC-MS is a strong advantage.

• Solid histology experience: tissue sectioning (cryostat and/or microtome), immunohistochemistry and immunofluorescence staining, fluorescence/confocal microscopy and quantitative analysis of large image batches (e.g. ImageJ/Fiji, QuPath). Experience with staining and quantifying brain pathology (amyloid-β plaques, tau, neuroinflammation markers) is a plus.

• Cellular biology experience, in particular mammalian cell culture and flow cytometry / FACS (sample preparation, acquisition, gating and analysis). Experience with functional cell assays such as phagocytosis is an advantage.

• Careful, reliable and well-documented working style, the ability to work independently and organise large experimental cohorts, and a collaborative team spirit.

• Solid knowledge of English and good communication skills.

Die Universität Zürich, die größte Universität der Schweiz, bietet eine Reihe attraktiver Positionen in verschiedenen Fachgebieten und Berufsfeldern. Mit rund 10.000 Mitarbeitern und derzeit 12 beruflichen Ausbildungsströmen bietet die Universität ein inspirierendes Arbeitsumfeld für Spitzenforschung und erstklassige Bildung. Setzen Sie Ihr Talent und Ihre Fähigkeiten ein, um mit uns zu arbeiten. Erfahren Sie mehr über die UZH als Arbeitgeber!

Aufgaben:
Der ausgewählte Kandidat wird eine zentrale Rolle im In-vitro- und In-vivo-Programm der Gruppe einnehmen. Zu den Aufgaben gehören: (i) Einrichtung von In-vitro- und In-vivo-Modellen für die Blut-Hirn-Schranke im Labor und Testmedikamentenkandidaten in solchen Modellen unter Verwendung von ELISA oder LC-MS usw.; (ii) Verarbeitung von Hirngewebe für histologische und biochemische Assays, einschließlich Sektionierung (Kryostat/Mikrotom), Immunhistochemie und Immunfluoreszenzfärbung, Fluoreszenz/konfokale Bildgebung, quantitative Großserienbildanalyse, ELISA und Western-Blot-Assays für Gehirnhomogenate; und (iii) Unterstützung von zellbasierten Assays, einschließlich Säugerzellkultur, Mikrogliaphagozytose-Assays und Durchflusszytometrie (FACS). Der Kandidat wird auch zu standardmäßigen biochemischen Auslesungen (z. B. ELISA, Western Blot) und zur sorgfältigen Dokumentation der experimentellen Daten beitragen.

Anforderungen:
• PhD-Abschluss in Biologie, Neurowissenschaften, Biomedizin oder einem verwandten Bereich. Erfahrung in der Wirkstoffforschung bei Neurodegeneration ist ein Plus.

• Hands-on-Erfahrung mit Blut-Hirn-Schranke-Forschung, einschließlich der Einrichtung von in-vitro-und in-vivo-Modelle, quantitative Analyse der drug penetration. Erfahrung mit LC-MS ist ein großer Vorteil.

• Erfahrung mit solider Histologie: Gewebeschnitt (Kryostat und/oder Mikrotom), Immunhistochemie und Immunfluoreszenzfärbung, Fluoreszenz/Konfokalmikroskopie und quantitative Analyse großer Bildansätze (z. B. ImageJ/Fiji, QuPath). Erfahrungen mit der Färbung und Quantifizierung der Hirnpathologie (Amyloid-β-Plaques, Tau, Neuroinflammationsmarker) sind ein Plus.

• Erfahrung in der Zellbiologie, insbesondere in der Zellkultur von Säugetieren und der Durchflusszytometrie / FACS (Probenpräparation, Gewinnung, Gating und Analyse). Erfahrungen mit funktionellen Zellassays wie Phagozytose sind von Vorteil.

• Sorgfältiger, zuverlässiger und gut dokumentierter Arbeitsstil, die Fähigkeit, unabhängig zu arbeiten und große experimentelle Kohorten zu organisieren, und ein kooperativer Teamgeist.

• Solide Englischkenntnisse und gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten.

titleByLocale.fr: Professeur de gastroentérologie et d'hépatologie

jobs.description:
The University of Zurich offers a wide range of attractive positions in various subject areas and professional fields. With around 10,000 employees and 12 professional apprenticeship streams, Switzerland's largest university provides an inspiring working environment at the vanguard of research and education. Find out more about UZH as an employer!

Aufgaben:
We are seeking a dynamic, integrative, and collaborative individual with extensive clinical and scientific experience in gastroenterology or hepatology. A habilitation or an equivalent academic qualification, as well as board certification in gastroenterology (FMH), or an equivalent international qualification, are required. As the future head of the Department of Gastroenterology and Hepatology, we expect the successful candidate to possess a successful leadership track record as head or deputy head of a clinical unit at a university hospital. In addition, you have a strong track record as a research group leader, you have secured competitive third-party funds, and contributed to student teaching, supervision of academic theses, and the promotion of early-career researchers.

We are looking for a participative and integrative leader with proven experience in fostering collaborative, interdisciplinary teamwork. You are able to connect teams across different departments, establish a culture of mutual respect, and actively contribute to the advancement of research, teaching, and clinical care.

Anforderungen:
The University of Zurich offers exceptional conditions for cutting-edge medical research. With its four University Hospitals, the University of Zurich provides access to extensive patient populations, interdisciplinary re-search networks, and clinical expertise across all age groups and specialties. Its proximity to ETH Zurich offers additional opportunities for collaboration in computational medicine, bioengineering, data science, and AI-driven medicine. As a result, the Zurich location offers a translational ecosystem that spans from basic research to clinical application.

German language skills at level B2 of the common European framework of reference for languages should be available or must be acquired within a reasonable period of time.

The University of Zurich is an equal opportunities employer and in particular strives to increase the percentage of women in leading positions. Therefore, qualified female researchers are encouraged to apply.

Our employees benefit from a wide range of attractive offers .

La sua vicinanza a ETH Zurich offre ulteriori opportunità di collaborazione in medicina computazionale, bioingegneria, scienza dei dati e medicina AI-driven. Di conseguenza, la posizione di Zurigo offre un ecosistema traduttivo che spazia dalla ricerca di base all'applicazione clinica.

Puisque vous prendrez en charge la gestion de la Clinique de gastroentérologie et d'hépatologie, vous aurez une expérience dans la gestion ou la gestion adjointe d'une unité clinique universitaire. De plus, vous avez une vaste expérience dans la gestion d'un groupe de recherche, l'acquisition d'un financement concurrentiel par des tiers ainsi que dans l'enseignement des étudiants, la supervision du travail de qualification et la promotion académique des jeunes talents.

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un leader participatif, axé sur la valeur et inclusif avec
expérience éprouvée dans la promotion du travail d'équipe coopératif et interdisciplinaire. Ils peuvent établir des réseaux d'équipes entre disciplines, établir une culture de travail reconnaissante et contribuer activement au développement de la recherche, de l'enseignement et des soins cliniques.

Exigences
L'Université de Zurich offre des conditions exceptionnelles pour la recherche de pointe en médecine. Avec ses quatre hôpitaux universitaires, il offre un accès à de vastes populations de patients, des réseaux de recherche interdisciplinaires et une expertise clinique pour tous les groupes d'âge et toutes les disciplines. La proximité de l'ETH Zurich ouvre des possibilités de coopération en médecine informatique, en bioingénierie, en data science et en médecine assistée par l'IA. L'emplacement de Zurich offre ainsi un écosystème orienté vers la traduction qui va de la recherche fondamentale à l'application clinique.

La connaissance de l'allemand au niveau B2 du Cadre européen commun de référence pour les langues devrait être disponible ou doit être acquise dans un délai utile.

L'Université de Zurich s'efforce d'accroître la proportion de femmes occupant des postes de direction. Par conséquent, les chercheuses qualifiées sont explicitement invitées à postuler.

jobs.title: CLARIN-CH Technical Officer

jobs.description:
The University of Zurich, Switzerland's largest university, offers a range of attractive positions in various subject areas and professional fields. With around 10,000 employees and currently 12 professional apprenticeship streams the University offers an inspiring working environment on cutting-edge research and top-class education. Put your talent and skills to work with us. Find out more about UZH as an employer!

Aufgaben:
We are looking for a highly motivated, curious and technically skilled Technical Officer to strengthen the CLARIN-CH Coordination Office and help bridge computational and data infrastructures with research in linguistics, digital humanities and related disciplines.

Key responsibilities

Researcher support
• Provide technical advice and practical support on language data, research data management, data workflows and Data Management Plans (DMPs).

• Support researchers in selecting and using appropriate standards and infrastructure services.

• Contribute to the CLARIN-CH FAIRification pipeline , identifying relevant datasets and tools and supporting their integration into CLARIN and CLARIN-CH infrastructures.

Infrastructure and FAIR data
• Contribute to developing, maintaining and improving technical solutions supporting FAIR and Open Research Data (ORD) practices in collaboration with the technical partners forming the CLARIN-CH ecosystem

• Support the integration and interoperability of repositories, metadata, data workflows and linguistic resources within the Swiss and European CLARIN ecosystem.

• Document and improve technical workflows supporting the accessibility, discoverability and reuse of language resources.

Anforderungen:
• MA/MSc or current PhD enrolment in computational/corpus linguistics, digital humanities, language technology, computer science or a related field.

• Demonstrated technical skills in language technology, data processing and/or research software development, including Python, APIs, JSON/XML, metadata schemas and GitHub/GitLab .

• Previous experience with research data management, DMP tools, data stewardship and/or research data infrastructures .

• Good knowledge of FAIR and ORD practices , preferably for language data.

• Familiarity with CLARIN infrastructures is an advantage.

• Strong technical curiosity and ability to learn new technologies quickly.

• Ability to work independently and collaboratively in an interdisciplinary environment.

• Good organisational and task-management skills.

Languages
• Excellent command of English required.

• Working capacity in German (native or min. B2) required.

• French and/or Italian is an advantage.
